integrity.literature_boundary: The exact theorem and proposition were inspected in the primary full text; broader continuous-frame literature is used only for comparison.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact Fourier-Plancherel identities and an injectivity/coordinate contradiction; no finite computation is used as evidence for an infinite-dimensional claim.
integrity.unproved_limits: No complete characterization of representable bounded maps from a Hilbert space into a nonatomic L2 space is asserted.

scientific_limitations: The result refutes only the implication from a continuous weak A-frame to existence of a Bessel weak A-dual in Theorem 3.20.
Pointwise Bessel representability is the exact missing property of the factor used in the proof; Hilbert--Schmidt regularity is only a sufficient condition, not a claimed characterization.
An unindexed erratum, thesis remark, or informal correction may contain the same source-specific observation.
title: A Fourier-unitary obstruction to Bessel weak \(A\)-duals
